author: Jaime Botero
releaseNotes: 0.235 (stable): Flair Vents integration with the established Dynamic Airflow Balancing strategy and the latest reviewed fixes. Delivered as a single Hubitat Bundle (app + Flair vents driver).
betaReleaseNotes: 0.237 (beta): Fixes the 0.236 discovery failure (GitHub issue #7): NullPointerException in handleDeviceList that aborted vent onboarding, leaked API-throttle slots wedging the request counter at 8/8 and starving all API traffic, the Setup page never auto-refreshing during authentication, and HPM showing 'vnull' as the bundle version. Retains the full DAB v2 'balance' feature set introduced in 0.236. Existing installs keep the legacy DAB strategy by default; new installs use 'balance' (parity-gated).
